_readme: REAL captures from a live, logged-in App Block run on 2026-08-17, taken through
the browser bridge against custom-generators.civit.ai and model-benchmarking.civit.ai
inside civitai.com/apps/run/<slug>.
🔴 DO NOT REGENERATE THESE FROM evidence.py. A fixture emitted by the code under
test makes every case valid by construction: the analyser would be graded against
its own output and a wrong parser would agree with itself. That exact mistake was
made once already in this skill's P2/P3 gates (a synthesised `observed` fixture),
and the killing mutation passed the whole suite. To refresh, re-capture live:
browser --instance work open https://civitai.com/apps/run/<slug> --wake=4000
browser --tab <t> frames                         # the id CHANGES every load
browser --tab <t> --frame <f> js "$(evidence.py probe-js install)"
browser --tab <t> --frame <f> html --max-bytes 0 > <name>.dom.json
browser --tab <t> --frame <f> js "$(evidence.py probe-js drain)" > <name>.probe.json
PROVENANCE OF THE CONSOLE/NETWORK CONTENT, stated plainly: the DOM captures are
untouched app output, but the console messages and the failed request in
cg-explainer.probe.json were INDUCED during capture by injecting an inline
<script> that logged, threw, and fetched a nonexistent host. They are real
captured probe output of real browser events — they are NOT app defects, and no
gate may read them as such. cg-discover.probe.json is an untouched drain and is
genuinely empty, which is what makes it the paired zero case.
The a11y ZEROES below are real: these two apps use the shared @civitai/blocks-react
control pack and pass all four checks. That is why the suite mutates a COPY of the
real DOM to build each check's positive control — see gate E4.
🔴 THE CORPUS CONTAINS NO EMPTY SCREEN — every real capture has at least one
card — so the empty-state check's silence on it is not evidence that it works.
Each probe below therefore EXCISES a real element from a real capture, with
.claude/skills/app-capture/tests/fixtures/domsurgery.py: an independent tag-depth scanner that
shares no code with evidence.py's parser, asserts the opening tag occurs exactly
once, and asserts the extracted span is tag-balanced. Nothing here is invented
markup — `cut` only removes what the app really rendered, and `duplicate` only
repeats it.
`expect` is what the check MUST say about the edited DOM; the UNEDITED file is
the paired arm and must say `populated` with defect false.

empty-with-next-action.note: the list empties; the Submit CTA one level up is still there, so this is a finding, not a defect

empty-with-no-next-action.note: nothing to look at and nothing to do — the reportable UX defect

empty-names-the-missing-input.note: an emptied list whose search box is unfilled — the check names the input rather than guessing why the list is empty

_readme: 🔴 THE DIFF BLINDNESS THIS EXISTS TO CLOSE. A grid going 24 -> 39 testid
OCCURRENCES reported `unchanged: 15` on the first live run, because the id SET
never moved. Duplicating one REAL card twice reproduces exactly that shape:
same 15 ids, 15 -> 31 occurrences.
One entry per check. Each is a MINIMAL, mechanical edit to a REAL captured DOM
that MUST make exactly that check fire, and MUST move no other check's count.
`find` must occur EXACTLY ONCE in the named capture — the suite asserts that
before replacing. A count=1 replace that lands on an occurrence you did not
picture makes a guard look real when it is not; that has already happened in
this skill's mutation battery, so the count is checked rather than assumed.
`violating` is the edit that must produce exactly one violation of this check.
`clean` is the paired arm that must produce ZERO. Where `clean` is absent the
UNEDITED capture is the clean arm — the same file through the same parser.
🔴 img-alt is the honest exception: the real corpus contains NO ELEMENT AT
ALL (the one `<img` in mb-combos sits inside a CSS comment in a <style> block).
So this check's silence on the untouched corpus is NOT evidence it works, and
both of its arms therefore INSERT an img — one without alt (must fire) and one
with alt="" (must not). Stated here so nobody reads the zero as coverage.

interactive-name.note: the real 'Got it' button, stripped of its only accessible name

img-alt.note: no exists in the real corpus — both arms insert one; see _readme

control-label.note: the real search input keeps its placeholder, so this also pins that a placeholder is NOT a label
